about: Writing judge for /spike findings.md. Yes/no questions; pass when at least the bar is yes. good.md must pass and bad.md must fail before the judge's scores are trusted (Test-Judge.ps1).
questions: Does the short answer answer the question asked in one or two sentences?
Are there at most 3 options, each with an effort (S, M or L) and a risk?
Is there exactly one recommendation, and does it say why?
Does it name real code (files, classes or methods) instead of generic advice?
Is the next step a concrete action someone could take this week?
